id.help: Unique id; units list it in weapons.

props.help: Numbers the formulas read as w.<name> (might, ...).

damage.help: Formula that replaces the game's damage formula for this weapon.

damageKind.help: Free word that skills can test.

damageType.help: One of the game's damageTypes (first listed if absent).

fire.help: line: the shot hits the first unit on a straight line.

area.help: Area attack: also hits squares around the target (docs/SRPG.md Area attacks).

shape.help: burst = radius 1; line needs length; radius and cross need radius.

friendlyFire.help: Also hurts the attacker's own side.

vertical.help: Levels of height the blast reaches (needs rules.height).

apCost.help: Action points for an attack (needs rules.actionPoints).

heightRange.help: How many levels higher / lower the target may stand (needs rules.height).

chargeSpeed.help: Makes the weapon a charged action (needs turnOrder speed).

chargeTargets.help: unit: follows the unit; cell: hits the square (needs chargeSpeed).

interruptedBy.help: Conditions that cancel the charge (needs chargeSpeed).

wieldedBy.help: Only these characters may use it.

wieldedByTypes.help: Only these unit types may use it.
